product_summary: Website geeenterprises.in (reachable homepage; sub-pages return 404) describes the firm as 'manufacturing, wholesaling, trading and supplying' housekeeping items, stationery items, packing material and cartridges from Sadar Bazar, Delhi. Listed categories: Kitchenware (aluminium cookware, steel cookware, hard-anodised, tri-ply, stainless steel bottles, dinner sets, tawa/dosa tawa/frypan, kadai, thermoware, insulated steel bottles); Material Handling Products (series crates, industry-wise crates, pallets, roto-moulded products); Housekeeping Items (spin mop bucket, standee mops, brushes, sponges, wipes, garbage bags, cloths, gloves, wipers, brooms); Packing and Storage Solution (lunch boxes & tiffins, jars, containers, flasks, plastic boxes, hydration products, bathware, furniture products, food storage products); Homeware and Gift Items. Contact e-mail on site is Kapil@geeenterprises.in, which corroborates the claimed proprietor name Kapil Rastogi. No product-level HS codes, no catalogue PDF and no customs lines were visible on the reachable page.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — self-described as 'manufacturing, wholesaling, trading and supplying'; the breadth of unrelated lines (steel cookware, aluminium cookware, roto-moulded crates, mops, stationery, cartridges) plus a Sadar Bazar wholesale address is a strong trader/multi-line distributor signal rather than a single-process converter. Trader status is not a rejection ground.
comment: HS comparison: declared 392310 is CORROBORATED — plastic crates, storage bins, plastic boxes and food-storage containers are explicitly listed. Declared 392410 is CORROBORATED — plastic jars, containers, lunch boxes/tiffins and hydration/bathware items fit tableware/kitchenware of plastics. Declared 392350 (caps/closures) is NOT corroborated: no caps, lids or closures appear as a product line on the site; it may exist as an accessory line but is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Verdict: partial match, no rejection — per Rule 3 the company is kept and the code list is corrected/expanded. Missing from the declaration: a large non-plastic share of the range — stainless steel cookware/tableware (732393/732394), aluminium cookware (761510), vacuum/thermo ware (961700), brushes/mops/brooms (9603), garbage bags (392321/392329), plastic furniture and stationery (392610). Industry misclassification: the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) does not fit — the actual profile is houseware/kitchenware, plastic material-handling (crates, pallets) and housekeeping/cleaning supplies wholesale. Material-handling crates and pallets are the only lines with any construction/logistics adjacency. All product data here is from the company's own website only: every code above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or B-L was available to me, and I did not research registries, revenue or shipment volumes per role scope. Sub-pages (/our-products, /about-us, category pages) returned 404, so the catalogue could not be itemised further; a full SKU-level HS check would need the actual catalogue or a customs record.
